verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include a 'Test Data' section paired with 'Moving to Production' (kushki-docs-11, kushki-docs-36) and a page on Apple Pay sandbox testing (kushki-docs-26), so a first-party test environment with test data exists. The evidence is only page titles, though, so its depth is unproven: nothing shows the sandbox mirrors production or that test cards cover declines or disputes. missing for 10: documented test cards for decline scenarios, dispute/chargeback simulation, evidence the sandbox mirrors production behavior across the full flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
